technical-data.invention-title: METHOD AND APPARATUS FOR PURIFICATION AND DISINFECTION OF LIQUIDS
PROCEDE ET DISPOSITIF DE PURIFICATION ET DE DESINFECTION DE LIQUIDES

abstract.p: The method consists of magnetic-ionic treatment of the liquid flow with a sign-variable constant magnetic field and copper and silver ions liberated therein, whereupon the flow is led through three kinds of natural materials consecutively arranged within the sweep of the magnetic field. The apparatus comprises an inlet magnetic module (1), followed by an ionizing module (2) with copper (2') and silver (2'') ion liberating electrodes, the outlet thereof being connected to purification activating module (3), which represents a two-layer filter, the first layer (3') thereof consisting of amorphous minerals with cationic and filtering properties, while the second layer (3'') consists of mineral crystals with filtering properties and specific, bioactivating energetic radiations. A harmonizing module (4) of mineral crystals is connected to the outlet of the purification activating module (3), said minerals being treated with frequency modulated energetic radiations. All modules (1-4) of the apparatus are contained in tubular housings (A, B) within the sweep of the magnetic field created by the magnetic module (1), and connected into a common tubular system with an inlet (a) and an outlet (b).

Ce procédé consiste en un traitement magnéto-ionique du courant de liquide dans un champ magnétique constant modulé en polarité avec dégagement d'ions Cu et Ar. En l'occurrence, on fait traverser au courant trois espèces naturelles se suivant dans le volume d'un champ magnétique. L'appareil comporte un module d'entrée (1) magnétique puis un module d'ionisation (2) dont les électrodes libèrent des ions Cu (2') et Ar (2''). La sortie de ce module est raccordée à un module à filtre actif (3), en l'occurrence un filtre à deux couches. La première de ces couches (3') est faite de minéraux cationiques filtrants amorphes. La seconde de ces couches (3'') est constituée de cristaux minéraux filtrants produisant des rayonnements spécifiques bioactifs. Un module d'harmonisation (4) des cristaux minéraux est raccordé à la sortie du module à filtre actif (3). Ces minéraux subissent un rayonnement d'énergie à modulation de fréquence. Tous les modules (1-4) de l'appareil, qui sont contenus dans des enceintes tubulaires (A, B) à l'intérieur du volume du champ magnétique créé par le module magnétique (1), sont raccordés à un système tubulaire commun comportant une entrée (a) et une sortie (b).

description.p: METHOD AND APPARATUS FOR PURIFICATION AND DISINFECTION OF LIQUIDS

The present invention relates to a method of and apparatus for purification and disinfection of liquids, in particular all kinds of drinking water, water for medication and prophylaxis, for use in the everyday life, for sports rehabilitation and melioration, as well as of high water content liquids used in medicine, the food industry, agriculture and everyday life.
Prior Art.
There are a method and an apparatus known for purification of liquids from furr forming carbonates through magnetic treatment of the liquid flow [1].
The method consists in that the liquid is treated by leading it through an area with a sign-variable (pulsatory) constant magnetic field, the field lines cutting across the liquid flow.

The apparatus for carrying out the method represents a diamagnetic tubular body with an inlet and an outlet opening for the liquid, in the body there being disposed a magnetic system consisting of pulsatory magnetic sections with zigzag channels for the liquid. Flowing through those channels, the liquid treated (water) is subjected to a layer-by-layer highly efficient magnetic action.

As a result of the magnetic action, the carbonates dissolved in the liquid turn into fine crystals incapable of forming dense carbonate deposits in the pipelines (furr) that are difficult to remove. Those fine crystals remain during further filtration of the liquid.

Besides, the magnetic field acting upon the liquid has to a certain extent the effect of a disinfectant, for it has a bactericide effect on some microorganisms and reduces the vitality of others.
At the same time, the magnetic field neutralizes to a great extent the deforming effect of different operators, such as electromagnetic, high-frequency radiations and pollutions (chlorine, ozone, etc.) on the physical structure of the liquid, bringing it close to its original form, i.e. that of a liquid crystal.
There is a method of and apparatus for disinfection of liquids (water) by means of a combined treatment of the liquid flow through magnetic and ionic action [2].

The method consists in leading the liquid (water) through an area with a pulsatory constant magnetic field, the lines of the latter cutting across the liquid flow, which participates in an electrolysis process between ion liberating copper and silver electrodes within the sweep of the magnetic field.

The apparatus for realizing the method represents a tubular diamagnetic housing with an inlet and an outlet opening for the liquid, in which there is disposed a magnetic system of peripheral and a central sections of constant magnets creating a pulsatory constant magnetic field, whose lines are perpendicular to the liquid flow. In the space between the peripheral magnetic sections and the central one there are disposed two pairs of ion liberating copper and silver electrodes with an electronic- control pulsatory constant current supply.

The above method and apparatus for disinfection of liquids serves to achieve a high synergetic effect of fast and lasting disinfection, i.e. purification of the liquid from microorganism pollutions (bacteria, viruses, algae). The effect is a result of the simultaneous ionic action of copper and silver ions, which destroy the microorganisms in the liquid down to a satisfactory from sanitary point of view degree, and a magnetic action intensifying the disinfection process with a strongly reduced concentration of the ions, for it facilitates their access to the microorganism cells and stabilizes the liberated in the liquid, together with the ions, peroxide compounds of the hypochloride. Besides, the
magnetic action has the effect of purification of the liquid from furr forming carbonates known from [1].

In spite of the undeniable qualities of the above methods and the apparatuses for their realization, neither of them settles the issue of creating a technically simple, respectively sparing but highly efficient at the same time, sanitary treatment of liquids with a high water content, said treatment helping to achieve both purification of the liquid from mechanical polluting agents with non-organic, including mineral, composition and organic, including disease causing, composition (bacteria, viruses, algae), as well as from chemical pollutants, including carbonates, heavy metals and ammonia, and full restoration of its deformed physical structure up to its natural form of pure spring water able to stimulate and harmonize the vital processes in the human organisms that have absorbed it.
Technical Substance of the Invention

The method of purification and disinfection of liquids with a high water content, according to the invention, consists of an initial magnetic treatment of the liquid flow by creating in the space it passes through of a pulsatory constant magnetic field, whose lines cut it across, as well as ionic treatment of the flow by copper and silver ions liberated therein as a result of electrolysis passing under the conditions of the magnetic field that crosses it. Following the magnetic-ionic action upon the flow, the latter is subjected to chemical and physical actions by leading it through three kinds of natural materials consecutively arranged within the crossing magnetic field. The first of those materials has cationitic and filtering properties, the second one possesses filtering properties and specific, biologically activating energetic radiations (waves), and the third material is characterized by specific energetic radiations (waves), harmonizing the bioenergetic processes in a living organism.
The apparatus for realizing the method, according to the invention, consists of consecutively connected functional modules the flow to be treated passes through. According to the flow treatment technological procedure, determined by the method, the inlet module is magnetic and comprises a system for the creation of a sign-variable (pulsatory) constant magnetic field, the lines thereof being perpendicular to the flow passing through the module. It is followed by a ionizing module with two pairs of ion liberating copper and silver electrodes fed by alternate direct voltage. The outlet of the ionizing module is connected to a purification activating module representing a two-layer filter, the first layer thereof consisting of minerals with amorphous structure and cationitic and filtering properties, and the second layer consisting of mineral crystals with filtering properties and specific, bioactivating energetic radiations. The outlet of the purification activating module is connected to a harmonizing module consisting of mineral crystals, that have been pre-processed (irradiated) by frequency-modulated energetic oscillations. Besides, all modules of the apparatus are placed in tubular housings connected by pipe joints into a common tubular system with an outlet and an inlet opening, and all parts thereof (housings and joints) are spatially disposed within the sweep of the lines of the magnetic field created in the magnetic module, and orientated so as to allow the flow passing therethrough be always perpendicular to the magnetic lines.

According to a structural version of the apparatus, which is preferred in the treatment of liquids with a flowrate of up to 0,2 l/sec. , the tubular system comprises two parallel housings, the magnetic module being placed in the first (inlet) housing and the rest modules (ionizing, purifying, purification activating, harmonizing) being disposed in the second housing.

Another structural version of the apparatus, preferred in the treatment of liquids with a flowrate of over 0,2 l/sec, the tubular system comprises two parallel housings too, but the first housing contains the
magnetic and the ionizing modules, while the other three modules of the apparatus (purifying, purification activating, harmonizing) are disposed in the second housing.

In a construction embodiment of the first structural version of the apparatus, preferred in the treatment of strongly polluted drinking water and liquids, the first housing of its tubular system represents a diamagnetic cylindrical pipe with the magnetic system of the magnetic module being disposed therein, said system consisting of alternate magnetic sections with zigzag channels for the liquid flow. The second housing thereof represents a cone-shaped or cylindrical container made of corrosion-proof diamagnetic (polymer) material. The container consists of a body and a head with an inlet and an outlet chambers for the flow. The inlet opening of the inlet chamber and the outlet opening of the outlet chamber are opposite and coaxial, the axes thereof lying in a horizontal plane. In the lower part of the body of the container there is a cone-shaped constriction ending with a flat horizontal bottom having a central opening with a screw plug therein. Along the body axis there is disposed the ionizing module, which represents a cylindrical pipe made of corrosion-proof material, e.g. polymer, the lower end of said pipe being attached to the body bottom, and its upper end - to the outlet opening of the inlet chamber. Along the whole periphery of the lower part of the pipe there are longitudinal slots (nozzles) less than 0,2 mm wide for the liquid to flow out. In the upper part of the pipe there are attached, at two levels, the two pairs of copper and silver electrodes of the ionizing module, which are externally connected to an electronic microprocessor control module of the apparatus. There are horizontal meshy partitions at three levels in the body, said partitions having the dimensions of the respective cross-sections of the body and a central opening, the same for the three partitions, with the diameter of the ionizing module pipe. The bottom and the middle partitions delimit the area where the first layer of the two-layer filter is disposed - a purification module made of chemically activated zeolite. The middle
and the upper partitions delimit respectively the area occupied by the second layer of the filter, said layer consisting of silicic crystals. In the area of the outlet chamber of the head, close to its outlet opening, there is a corrosion-proof cell with the harmonizing module placed therein, the latter consisting of rock crystals (quartz).

In a construction embodimentof the second structural version of the apparatus, fit for treatment of any kinds of waters and liquids with a high flowrate, the first housing of its tubular system represents a cylindrical pipe made of corrosion-proof diamagnetic material with the magnetic system of the magnetic module placed therein, the magnetic system consisting of peripheral and central sections of permanent magnets, and the two pairs of copper and silver electrodes of the ionizing module. The second housing represents a cone-shaped or cylindrical container made of corrosion-proof diamagnetic (polymer) material. There is a conical constriction in the lower part of the container, ending with a cylindrical inlet opening, and a flat cover attached to its upper end with a central cylindrical outlet opening. There are horizontal meshy partitions disposed at three levels in the container, the dimensions of which correspond to the respective passage section of the container. The lower and the middle partitions delimit an area comprising the first layer of the two-layer filter, i.e. of the purification activating module, said layer consisting of chemically activated zeolite. The middle and the upper partitions delimit an area occupied by the second filter layer consisting of silicic crystals. In the space between the upper partition and the cylindrical outlet opening in the cover of the container there is disposed a corrosion-proof cell, which contains the harmonizing module consisting of quarz crystals.

The advantages of the method and the apparatus for purification and disinfection of liquids, according to the invention, have two aspects. On one hand, the method ensures highly efficient, both purifying and disinfecting, restoring, biologically activating and harmonizing the liquid crystal structure treatment of the liquid by a complex of functionally
bound physical and chemical actions upon the liquid flow, most of them being compatible as regards the time and place of their application. The high-degree effects of purification, disinfection, structural restoration, activation and harmonization (imparting of biostimulating and bioharmonizing properties) of the liquid are due to the synergism between the simultaneous or consecutive processes acting upon its flow, namely:

- the alternate pulsatory constant magnetic field frees the liquid from carbonates dissolved therein, disinfects it to a great extent, restores its deformed crystal structure, and raises its wholesome life- stimulating biological activity;

- the copper and silver ions, liberated in the liquid through electrolysis under the action of the magnetic field, accelerating their liberation and motion, destroy the disease-causing microorganisms therein, protect it against further microorganic pollution (preserve it) and, getting into a living organism (biological structure) through the liquid, they intensify its life-stimulating effect thereon owing to its magnetization;

- the purification activating process consists of a first purification of the liquid from heavy metals, ammonia and other chemical pollutants, from some mechanical pollutants, as well as enrichment thereof with ions (sodium and potassium) having a life-stimulating effect on the organism having absorbed them through the liquid, and the natural material with cationite and filtration properties that realizes those actions gets preserved by the copper and silver ions having reached it through the liquid, while the processes of preservation and filtration are intensified by the magnetic field, within the sweep of which the material is disposed. Besides, the process comprises detention of all mechanical pollutants with organic or inorganic composition and certain dimensions, such detention being carried out by a second natural material having filtration properties, intensified by the magnetic field within the sweep of which the material is disposed, and having also
specific energetic radiations additionally intensifying the life-stimulating effect of the liquid irradiated thereby, that owing to the magnetic and ionic pre-treatment of the liquid. The second material gets preserved too by the copper and silver ions having reached it through the liquid, the preservation being intensified by the magnetic field;

- the harmonizing process represents irradiation of the liquid having undergone the preceding treatments with the specific harmonizing radiations of a third natural material carrying coded (by frequency modulation) information for harmonization of the bioenergetic, respectively life processes in an organism which has absorbed the irradiated liquid. The harmonizing radiations intensify the life-stimulating effect caused by the magnetic-ionic treatment of the liquid.

On the other hand, the integral complex of synergetic liquid treating effects under the method allow to create a simple and compact, highly efficient, easy and cheap to make apparatus for treatment. It comprises a minimum of interconnected and interdependent functional elements (modules), each of them producing several mutually intensifying effects on the liquid. The compactness of the apparatus is prompted by the necessity that all processes in the ionizing, purification activating and harmonizing modules thereof pass within the sweep of the alternate pulsatory magnetic field created by the magnetic module. Compactness allows to use a minimum of construction elements or housings, containing the functional modules and pipe joints between the housings of the apparatus.
Description of the Enclosed Figures
Fig. 1 represents a block diagram of the apparatus realizing the method of the invention.

Fig. 1.A is a block diagram of a structural version of the apparatus preferred for liquids with a flow-rate of up to 0,2 l/sec.
Fig. 1.B is a block diagram of a structural version of the apparatus preferred where the flow-rate if over 0,2 l/sec.
Fig. 2 represents a side view with a partial section of a construction embodiment of the structural apparatus version of Fig. 1.A.
Fig. 3 represents a side view with a partial section of a construction embodiment of the structural apparatus version of Fig. 1.B.
Embodiments of the Invention.

According to the block diagram of the apparatus realizing the method of the invention (Fig. 1), the apparatus consists of consecutively connected functional modules complied with the effects on the flow as provided for by the method, said modules forming a flow channel with an inlet "a" and an outlet "b". The inlet module 1 is magnetic and comprises a system for the creation of an alternate pulsatory constant magnetic field, the lines thereof being perpendicular to the flow passing through the module. Then follows a ionizing module 2 with two pairs of ion-liberating copper and silver electrodes fed by alternate constant voltage. The outlet of the ionizing module 2 is connected to a purification activating module 3, which represents a two- layer filter, the first layer 3 thereof consisting of minerals with amorphous structure, said minerals possessing cationitic and filtering properties, and the second layer 3" consisting of mineral crystals with filtering properties and specific, bioactivating energetic radiations. The outlet of the purification activating module 3 is connected to the harmonizing module 4, the latter consisting of mineral crystals, pre- irradiated with specific, frequency modulated, i.e. charged with coded harmonization information, energetic oscillations (radiations). Besides, all modules 1 to 4 of the apparatus are contained in tubular housings, which are connected by means of pipe joints into a common tubular system with an inlet opening "a" and an outlet opening "b", and its parts
(housings and joints) are spatially disposed within the sweep of the lines of the magnetic field created in the magnetic module 1 , and they are oriented so as to allow the flow passing therethrough be always perpendicular to the magnetic lines. According to a structural version of the apparatus (Fig. 1.A), preferred in the treatment of liquids with a flow-rate of up to 0,2 l/sec, the tubular system comprises two parallel housings A and B, in the first one (inlet) A there being placed the magnetic module 1 , and all the rest modules of the apparatus (ionizing 2, purification activating 3 and harmonizing 4) being contained in the second housing B.

According to another structural version of the apparatus (Fig. 1.B) preferred in the treatment of liquids with a flow rate of over 0,2 l/sec, the tubular system also comprises two parallel housings, but the first housing contains the magnetic module 1 and the ionizing module 2, while the second one contains the other two modules of the apparatus (the purification activating 3 and the harmonizing 4).

According to a construction embodiment of the first structural version of the apparatus (Fig. 2) preferred in the treatment of strongly polluted drinking water and liquids, the first housing A of its tubular system represents a cylindrical diamagnetic pipe with the magnetic system of the magnetic module 1 being placed therein, said magnetic system consisting of alternate magnetic sections with zigzag channels for the liquid flow. The second housing B represents a conical or cylindrical container made of corrosion-proof diamagnetic material, e.g. polymer. The container B consists of a body B' and a head B" with separate inlet chamber K' and outlet chamber K" for the flow. The inlet opening of the inlet chamber K' and the outlet opening of the outlet chamber K" are opposite and coaxial, their axes lying in a horizontal plane.There is a cone-shaped constriction in the lower part of the body B', said constriction ending with a flat horizontal bottom with a central opening containing a screw plug. Along the body B' there is disposed the ionizing module 2, which represents a cylindrical pipe made of
corrosion-proof material, e.g. polymer, the lower end of the pipe being attached to the bottom of the body B', and its upper end being connected to the outlet opening of the inlet chamber K' of the head B". In the lower part of the pipe 2, all along its periphery, there are rectangular slots (nozzles) less than 0,2 mm wide for the liquid to flow out. In the upper portion of the pipe 2 there are fixed, at two levels, the two pairs of copper 2' and silver 2" electrodes of the ionizing module 2, which are externally connected to an electronic microprocessor control module 5 of the apparatus. At three levels in the body B', there are disposed horizontal meshy corrosion-proof partitions, each having the dimensions of the respective cross-sections of the body B' and a central opening the same for the three partitions, which has the same diameter as that of the pipe of the ionizing module 2. The lower and the middle partitions delimit the space with the first layer 3' of the two-layer filter from the purification activating module 3, said layer 3' consisting of chemically activated zeolite. The middle and the upper partitions delimit the space occupied by the second layer 3" of the filter, said layer consisting of silicic crystals. Within the space of the outlet chamber K" of the housing head B", near its outlet opening, there is disposed a spherical cell of a corrosion-proof grid containing the harmonizing module 4 made of quarz crystals.

According to a construction embodiment of the second structural version of the apparatus (Fig. 3) fit for the treatment of all kinds of waters and liquids with a high flow-rate, the first housing A of its tubular system represents a cylindrical pipe made of corrosion-proof diamagnetic material, said tube containing the magnetic system of the magnetic module 1 , which consists of peripheral and central sections of constant magnets and the two pairs of copper and silver electrodes of the ionizing module 2. The second housing B of the tubular system represents a conical or cylindrical container B' with a cover B", made of corrosion-proof diamagnetic (polymer) material. In the lower part of the container B' there is a cone-shaped constriction ending with a
cylindrical inlet opening for connection with the first housing A of the tubular system. The cover B", having a central cylindrical outlet opening, is attached to the upper end of the container B'. There are horizontal meshy corrosion-proof partitions disposed at three levels in the container B', said partitions having the dimensions of the respective flow section of the container. The lower and the middle partitions delimit a space with the first layer 3' of the two-layer filter of the purification activating module 3, consisting of chemically activated zeolite. The middle and the upper partitions delimit a space occupied by the second layer 3" of the filter, which consists of silicic crystals. In the space above the upper meshy partition, at the beginning of the cylindrical outlet opening in the cover B", there is disposed a spherical cell of a corrosion-proof grid, which contains the harmonizing module 4 consisting of quarz (rock) crystals.

Regardless of which structural version (Fig. 1A or Fig. 1 B) and construction embodiment of the apparatus (Fig. 2 or Fig. 3) are preferred, depending on the concrete necessities and conditions of work, the liquid treating process is always the same in accordance with the method. According to that process, the fluidized liquid (e.g. by means of a pumping appliance not shown in the figures) enters the inlet "a" of the apparatus and, flowing through the first (magnetic) module 1 , acting upon it by an alternate pulsatory constant magnetic field, gets free from the carbonates dissolved therein, the latter turning into fine crystals, gets disinfected to a certain extent, for the field reduces the vitality of the disease-causing microorganisms therein, and its deformed natural liquid crystal structure gets almost completely restored, its wholesome biological activity being intensified. Intensification of that activity, which becomes operative when the liquid gets into a living (human) organism and consists in energetic stimulation of its biological processes, respectively vitality, is achieved through the magnetic energy absorbed by the liquid crystal structure. After that, the flow passes through the ionizing module 2 (Figs. 1 , 1A, 2), where the
liberated through electrolysis copper and silver ions, whose liberation and motion are accelerated by the magnetic field of the module 1 , completely destroy the microorganisms infecting it, the cell membranes thereof acquiring better permeability for the ions under the action of the magnetic field. In the case of the apparatus of Figs. 1 B and 3 (with a magnetic module 1 and ionizing module 2 incorporated in a common housing A), the magnetic field in the electrolysis process is more intensive, so its effect on the liberation and motion speed of the ions, as well as on the reduction of the microorganism vitality is stronger. Here, the disinfection process is intensified by much lower concentrations of copper ions (0,1 to 0,35 mg/l) and of silver ions (0,005 to 0,025 mg/l), which are enough for the full destruction of microorganisms in the flow. Besides, in all versions of the two embodiments of the apparatus (Figs.1 to 3), there are copper and silver ions remaining free in the flow which preserve it, i.e. protect it against further microbiological pollution for a long time after its magnetic-ionic treatment. Those free ions, getting into a biological structure (organism) through the liquid, stimulate its vitality by improving its blood-making processes and its immunity. That biostimulating effect of the ions intensifies the energetic stimulation of the organism vitality by the magnetized liquid. Then follows treatment of the liquid when it passes through the purification activating module 3. The first layer of the latter, i.e. the cationitic layer 3' of chemically activated zeolite, arrests the heavy metals (Fe, Pb, Mn, etc.), ammonia, and other chemical pollutants contained in the liquid, and enriches it with separated therefrom sodium and potassium ions having biotic effect on the organism that has absorbed them, thus intensifying the vitality-stimulating effects of the liquid owing to its magnetic-ionic treatment in the above modules 1 and 2. Besides, that layer 3' retains a part of the mechanical pollutants of the liquid. The next layer 3" of the module, consisting of sylicic crystals, arrests all inorganic and organic mechanical pollutants of the liquid sized over 0,1 mm. At the same time, the layer irradiates the liquid with its specific
energetic emissions, thus increasing its biostimulating ability acquired during its treatment in the preceding modules 1 and 2 and in the cationitic layer 3' of the module 3. The free copper and silver ions from the ionizing module 2, that have reached with the liquid the filter layers 3' and 3", preserve the layers against further infection with microorganisms. Besides, the magnetic field of the module 1 , present in the module 3, intensifies the process of preservation of its layers 3' and 3", as well as the filtration process, the degree of the latter increasing by about 30%.

Finally, the flow passes through the last, harmonizing module 4 consisting of quarz (rock) crystals, which are pre-processed by irradiation with frequency modulated specific energetic oscillations (emissions) carrying coded information on the harmonization of the bioenergetic processes in a living organism (whose tissues are colloid water solutions of biological substances). Thus the specific energetic radiations of the crystals are adjusted in resonance with the frequency modulated oscillations treating them, i.e. they are frequency modulated. When the liquid flows through that module 4, its restored and activated (in the preceding modules 1 to 3) crystal structure gets an additional energy information charge from the frequency modulated emissions of the quarz crystals irradiating it. Besides, the liquid crystal structure possesses the property of memorizing the overall information from the complex energetic treatment in the apparatus and conveying it to the absorbing organism as a dynamic energy information stimulus, which intensifies and harmonizes its bioenergetic, respectively biological, life processes through the mechanisms of homeopathy and resonance- frequency relaxation. As a result of the described complex, synergetic effects on the liquid flow when passing through the modules 1 to 4, the flow gets out through the outlet "b" of the apparatus completely disinfected and pure, free of the most frequent and injurious to health mechanical and chemical pollutants, with a fully restored crystal liquid structure, charged with energy stimulating and harmonizing the
bioenergetic or life processes in each organism having absorbed it. As long as the intensive and harmonious life processes in organisms, especially human ones, are a touchstone of health, taking liquids, in particular waters treated under the method and with the apparatus of the invention, is an efficient and proved by practice way of prophylaxis and treatment of most of the psychosomatic, chronic and a number of severe infectious viral and bacterial diseases, such as influenza, hepatitis, dysentery, etc. Besides, it is absolutely harmless, without any injurious side effects of the liquid on the organism, like those of antibiotics and most of the chemical medicines. The healing and preventive effect of the so treated liquid (water) is much better and more lasting than that of medicines, since it stimulates and harmonizes the functioning of not only one diseased or threatened with disease organ, but of all organs and systems of the organism.

claim.claim-text: 1. A method of purification and disinfection of liquids with a high water content, consisting of magnetic treatment of the liquid flow with alternate pulsatory constant magnetic field created in the space it passes through, the lines of said field intersecting it crosswise, as well as ionic treatment of the flow with copper and silver ions liberated therein as a result of electrolysis passing under the conditions of the magnetic field crossing it, characterized by that, after the magnetic- ionic action on the flow, the latter is led through three kinds of natural materials consecutively arranged within the crossing magnetic field, the first material possessing cationitic and filtering properties, the second one having filtering properties and specific, biologically activating energetic radiations, and the third one being characterized by specific energetic radiations, harmonizing the bioenergetic processes in a living organism.

2. An apparatus for the realization of the method, according to claim 1 , comprising a magnetic module with a system for the creation of an alternate pulsatory constant magnetic field, whose lines are perpendicular to the flow passing therethrough, and a ionizing module with two pairs of ion liberating copper and silver electrodes, fed by alternate constant voltage, characterized by that the magnetic module (1) is an inlet module followed by the ionizing module (2), whose outlet is connected to a purification activating module (3) representing a two- layer filter, the first layer (3') thereof consisting of minerals with an amorphous structure and cationitic and filtering properties, as well as specific, biologically activating energetic radiations, the outlet of the purification activating module (3) being connected to a harmonizing module (4), consisting of mineral crystals that are pre-irradiated with frequency modulated energetic oscillations, all the modules (1-4) of the apparatus being placed in tubular housings connected by pipe joints into a common tubular system with an inlet (a) and an outlet (b)
opening, while all of its housings and joints are spatially disposed within the sweep of the lines of the magnetic field created in the magnetic module (1) and orientated so as to allow the flow passing therethrough be perpendicular to the magnetic lines.

3. An apparatus, according to claims 1 and 2, characterized by that its tubular system comprises two parallel housings (A and B), the first housing (A) containing the magnetic module (1), and the second housing (B) containing the rest modules (2-4) of the apparatus.

4. An apparatus, according to claims 2 and 3, characterized by that the first housing (A) of its tubular system contains the magnetic module (1) and the ionizing module (2), and the second housing (B) contains the other two modules (3 and 4) of the apparatus.

5. An apparatus according to claims 2 and 3, characterized by that the first housing (A) of its tubular system represents a cylindrical diamagnetic tube, containing the magnetic system of the magnetic module (1), said magnetic system consisting of alternate magnetic sections with zigzag channels for the flow, and the second housing (B) of its tubular system represents a cone-shaped or cylindrical container made of corrosion-proof diamagnetic material, said container consisting of a body (B') and a head (B") with a separate inlet chamber (K') and an outlet chamber (K"), the inlet opening of the inlet chamber (K') and the outlet opening of the outlet chamber (K") being opposite and coaxial, the axes thereof laying in a horizontal plane, there being a cone-shaped constriction in the lower part of the body (B') of the second housing (B), ending with a flat horizontal bottom with a central opening for a screw plug, the ionizing module (2) being disposed along the axis of the body (B'), said module representing a cylindrical corrosion-proof tube with its ends fixed to the bottom of the container body (B') and to the outlet opening of the inlet chamber (K') from the container head (B"), in the lower part of the tube along its periphery there being made longitudinal slots (nozzles), while in its upper part there are fixed, at two levels, the two pairs of copper (2') and silver (2") electrodes of the ionizing module
